column3: Organize Prototype 8 in its dedicated Area 2 branch
column4: Keep only the Prototype-8 folder and preserve every original development commit without squashing. The folder contents match the standalone Prototype-8 repository.
Checked the timing between each note and visual pulse. Fixed interaction and animation problems found during testing.
Added keyboard support and updated aria-pressed to communicate the sound state. Adjusted the layout for desktop and mobile screens.
Stored the playing state in JavaScript and prevented duplicate sound loops. Stopping the sound now also clears the visual pulse.
Used Tone.Draw.schedule() and a CSS pulse animation to make the flower briefly grow whenever a note plays.
Used Tone.Synth and Tone.Loop to play a repeating musical note. Added tap controls for starting and stopping the sound.
Added the page title, instructions and interactive flower using a semantic <button>. Connected the HTML page to its CSS, JavaScript and Tone.js files.
